verdict.rationale: Runway Dev offers an API, SDK, MCP connection and per-project credits, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence describes API keys with permission scopes, restricted access or least-privilege credentials for agents. Per-project billing and per-team cost visibility are adjacent features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
